name: ZakoProxy
description: ZakoAI Proxy for Scripting: Self-hosted Responses, Chat Completions, and Anthropic Messages API Relay with Liquid Glass WebUI, 36 built-in prompt profiles, Astra general execution strategy, multi-account failover, and native iOS console.

localizedDescriptions.zh: 基于 ckldy/ZakoProxyCLI 深度移植的自托管 AI API 中转代理。原生运行于 Scripting，具备 LocalDNS 风格的流光毛玻璃 Web 控制台（支持全屏 WebViewController/Safari/局域网）、OpenAI / Claude / Responses 多协议、36 款针对性提示词预设与 Astra 通用执行策略、多账号优先级故障转移与熔断、AES-256 本地加密存储及原生 iOS 控制台。
localizedDescriptions.en: Self-hosted Responses, Chat Completions, and Anthropic Messages API Relay for Scripting with Liquid Glass WebUI, built-in prompt profiles, failover, and native console.
